# Temple Scroll Column 53 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 53 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**53:1** An Ammonite and a Moabite shall not come into the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation none of them shall come into the assembly of the LORD, unto perpetuity,

**53:2** on account of the fact that they did not meet you with bread and with water in the way when you came out from Egypt, and because he hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Pethor of Aram-naharaim to curse you.

**53:3** But the LORD your God was not willing to listen to Balaam, and the LORD your God turned for you the curse into a blessing, because the LORD your God loved you.

**53:4** You shall not seek their peace and their good all your days, unto perpetuity.

**53:5** You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land.

**53:6** Sons who are born to them in the third generation may come into the assembly of the LORD.

**53:7** When you go out as a camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every evil thing.

**53:8** If there is among you a man who is not clean because of a night-occurrence, then he shall go out to the outside of the camp; he shall not come into the midst of the camp.

**53:9** And it shall be, toward the turning of evening he shall wash with water, and when the sun goes down he may come into the midst of the camp.

**53:10** And a place shall be for you outside the camp, and you shall go out there, outside.

**53:11** And a peg shall be for you upon your weapon; and it shall be, when you sit outside, you shall dig with it and turn back and cover your excrement.

**53:12** For the LORD your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you and to give your enemies before you; and your camp shall be holy, so that He does not see in you a thing of nakedness and turn away from behind you.

**53:13** You shall not hand over a slave to his master who has escaped to you from his master.

**53:14** With you he shall dwell, in your midst, in the place which he shall choose in one of your gates, in the good for him; you shall not oppress him.

**53:15** There shall not be a holy-woman from the daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a holy-man from the sons of Israel.

**53:16** You shall not bring the hire of a harlot or the price of a dog into the house of the LORD your God for any vow, for an abomination of the LORD your God are both of them, also both of them.

---

*EMET notes: Column 53 reworks Deuteronomy 23:3-18. "Holy-woman" and "holy-man" (qedeshah/qadesh) rendered literally to preserve the ironic use of the root q-d-sh for cult prostitutes. "Night-occurrence" (miqreh laylah) preserves the Hebrew euphemism. "Dog" in 53:16 is likely a reference to a male cult prostitute.*
